headline: Joe Kaeser's Retirement Gift at Siemens: A Rusty Mercedes?
summary:
(Bloomberg Opinion) -- By spinning off its energy generation business this week, Siemens AG took another step toward unwinding its unwieldy conglomerate structure.

Not far up the autobahn in Stuttgart there’s another German industrial conglomerate that could do with the same medicine: Daimler AG, owner of Mercedes-Benz and the world’s biggest truck maker. Happily, the architect of the Siemens reinvention, Chief Executive Officer Joe Kaeser, might be available to help.
